Parameters based on best fit using SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.

Parameters based on best fit using SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.

Measurement based on the approximate source longitude.

Measurement based on the source longitude. Due to a data gap in STEREO A COR2 at the time of this event, a triangulated measurement was not available. The measured parameters may vary slightly as a result.
Parameters based on best fit using SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.
Measurement based on the potential source location as well as the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT.

Parameters based on best fit using STEREO A COR2 and SOHO LASCO C2 imagery.
Updated measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.

Fairly speculative leading edge measurement using only Sun-Earth line coronagraphs which include SOHO and GOES with no STEREO Ahead imagery, therefore, there is high uncertainty in source longitude by up to 15 degrees.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in GOES CCOR-1.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2. Half width is less than 10 degrees in SOHO, appearing slightly more wide in STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between STEREO A COR2, and available SOHO LASCO C3 imagery at this time due to a downlink gap.
Measurement based on best fit among SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on probable, on-disk source location.
Measurement based on best fit between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2.

3D SOHO LASCO C2/C3 analysis using approximate source of far-sided filament, with updated Solar Orbiter EUVI 304 imagery observing a likely filament eruption spanning approximately E130-E90 (centered around E110, used here). Longitude could vary slightly as a result.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between STEREO A COR2 and the faint halo signature in SOHO LASCO C2.
Speculative triangulated measurement based on limited imagery from STEREO A COR2 and SOHO LASCO C2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between GOES CCOR-1 and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2.
Shock triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2.
Bulk triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulated measurement based on best fit among SOHO LASCO C2, STEREO A COR2, and GOES CCOR-1.
Updated measurement with imagery out to 21 solar radii. High confidence in front-sided fit.
Leading edge of the CME using triangulation between SOHO/GOES and STEREO A for determination of the source longitude.
3D STEREO A COR2 only analysis using the approximate source longitude around E26, near STEREO A COR2's east limb. With the uncertain source and lack of triangulation, longitude may vary.

Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2. There is uncertainty in this analysis due to this front in STEREO A COR2 also tracking well with a separate feature in SOHO, for CME: 2026-06-27T19:12; as such it is plausible there was a farsided simultaneous eruption that overlaps in COR2 but not in C2.

Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2. There is uncertainty in this analysis due to this front in STEREO A COR2 also tracking well with a separate feature in SOHO, for CME: 2026-06-27T18:53Z; as such it is plausible there was a farsided simultaneous eruption that overlaps in COR2 but not in C2.

Triangulation between STEREO A COR2 and SOHO LASCO C2, tracking a very faint leading edge. this leading edge is in close proximity to the leading edges of CMEs 2026-06-27T18:53Z and 2026-06-27T19:12Z, but did not track to them; as such this is likely a separate event amidst those two also on the farside.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C3 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C3 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.

Measurement based on the approximate source location. A triangulated measurement was not available as this CME is not visible in STEREO A COR2 imagery. The measured parameters may vary slightly as a result.

Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2/C3, STEREO A COR2, and GOES CCOR-1 imagery in SWPC_CAT. This CME exhibits deflection from the potential source location, possibly due to proximity to a coronal hole.

Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2 in SWPC_CAT as well as the potential source location. Limited imagery was available for a measurement due to the faint leading edge.
Measurement based on potential source location and the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2 in SWPC_CAT. The leading edge is not clearly measurable in GOES CCOR-1 imagery.
Measurement based on the best fit between GOES CCOR-1 and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT. The leading edge is faint and unclear in running difference imagery, and this measurement is approximate.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between STEREO A COR2, and the very faint front in SOHO LASCO C2 better observed in running difference imagery.

Single spacecraft 3D analysis as SOHO LASCO C2. Using the source location at N16W04, we find the front deflected NE, and without the ability to triangulate in real-time. As such, this region's eruptive history is referenced, and a latitude of N30 then fitting the longitude to E03 is used to approximate the parameters, and may vary as a result. This deflection does fit with the observed wide opening field lines in SDO AIA 193.
Measurement based on the best fit between SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.

Preliminary shock analysis with only several available GOES CCOR-1 frames. Due to the limited frames and full halo presentation, the shock width could vary, impacting speed. Current preliminary analysis of the shock is consistently around 1200 km/s, with high confidence in the latitude and longitude.

Updated 3D single spacecraft analysis using SOHO LASCO C3. STEREO A COR2 returns from a data gap at 2026-07-01T00:09Z and observes the CME material but the LE is just beyond the FOV at that time and cannot be tracked. This is enough to use COR2 to estimate the more northward latitude than preliminary analysis and estimate the half width, while no frames are officially included in the analysis.
Speculative, PRELIMINARY measurement based on early frames of SOHO LASCO C2 and GOES CCOR-1 as well as on visible source location.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Measurement based on approximate source location and best fit in SOHO LASCO C2.

Leading edge/bulk measurement using only SOHO/STEREO A as the CME is obscured by the pylon in GOES. Strong eastward deflection along the Earth-Sun line with high confidence as this is visually confirmed in EUV imagery.
Shock front incorporating very wide shock feature seen to the west in LASCO and to the southeast in STEREO A COR2A simultaneously. To do so requires a width >50 degrees.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2.
Leading edge measurement of the CME using SOHO C2, a few frames of SOHO C3, and STEREO A COR2A.
Parameters based on best fit using SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2 imagery. There may be some uncertainty with parameters due to overlapping features from the perspective of STEREO A COR2.
Parameters based on best fit using SOHO LASCO C2 and STEREO A COR2 imagery.
PRELIMINARY measurement based on best fit among GOES CCOR-1, STEREO A COR2, and early frames of SOHO LASCO C2 as well as on visible source location.
PRELIMINARY SHOCK measurement based only on source location and fit in GOES CCOR-1. Real-time data gaps in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2 cover the majority of the propagation of the CME.
Leading edge measurement of the CME along the Sun-Earth line using only SOHO and GOES imagery and knowledge of the suspected source location, as the CME is not seen well in STEREO A imagery.
Measurement based on approximate potential source location using SOHO LASCO C2 and GOES CCOR-1 imagery in SWPC_CAT.
Measurement based on the best fit between GOES CCOR-1 and STEREO A COR2 imagery in SWPC_CAT. Only one frame of STEREO A COR2 imagery was available for a measurement.
Measurement based on source location using GOES CCOR-1 imagery in SWPC_CAT.
Preliminary measurement based on source location using GOES CCOR-1 imagery in SWPC_CAT.
Simultaneous flaring is also observed from Active Region 14480 (S14W38) peaking around 2026-07-01T19:35Z.

Previously attributed to AR 14479 (N15W77), which appears to have a simultaneous flare starting slightly earlier as seen in SDO AIA 131 imagery.
